Tend the wounded troopers, or take their supply crate and go

Bring the archive record to an officer
mission.oldrepublic.i1_names.objective.a: Take the fence's book from Dovan Lisk's camp
mission.oldrepublic.i1_names.objective.r: Bring the book to the Imperial officer, or burn it in the camp's fire
mission.oldrepublic.i2_border_incident.o: Stop the Republic recon squad and decide their sergeant's fate
mission.oldrepublic.survey.objective.act: Reach the site's heart and cast Force Sense there
mission.oldrepublic.patrol_intercept.obj: Defeat the patrol and decide their sergeant's fate
mission.oldrepublic.stage.placing: Finding a place for the work...
Raiders have dug in beside a settler track and tax anyone who passes. The settlers will pay in supplies to see them gone.
A poacher crew on the ridge strips the hills of crystal and the farms of livestock. Clear them out.
Our water carts keep coming back empty and shot up. There's a raider camp past the fields. End it.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.survey.repu: Republic survey needs eyes on an old site nobody has charted. Reach its heart and tell us what you sense.
Command wants to know which ruins are waking up. Get to the site's heart, use your senses, report back.
An old site sits unmapped inside our patrol range. We need someone who feels what our instruments miss.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.survey.impe: Intelligence wants a reading from an old site in the region. Stand at its heart and listen.
The Empire catalogues what it may one day claim. Survey the site and give us its measure.
Our instruments see only stone. You may see more. Reach the old site's heart and use your gifts.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.secure_site: Something has woken the guardians of an old site near our lines. Put them down before they reach a patrol route.
Constructs or scavengers, whatever holds that site is a danger to travellers. Clear it.
We lost contact with a survey team near an old site. Find what guards it and end the threat.
An old site in our range has grown teeth again. The Empire does not tolerate rival claims. Clear it.
Intelligence reports movement at a nearby ruin. Remove whatever stands guard there.
The guardians of that site answer to someone who is not the Empire. Correct this.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.patrol_inte: An Imperial patrol crossed the treaty line and isn't turning back. Stop them before this becomes a war.
Imperial troopers have dug in on our side of the line and call it a survey. Send them home.
There's an Imperial squad where it shouldn't be. Command wants it handled quietly and quickly.
A Republic patrol has strayed over the treaty line. The Empire does not let that pass unanswered.
Republic troopers are probing our perimeter. Intercept them. Their sergeant may know something.
A Republic squad crossed the line under cover of a survey. Stop them before they report home.
Master Saelen: Raiders are camped beside the settlers' track. Drive them off. The people first, the camp second.
Master Saelen: A poacher crew has dug in nearby. The Watch keeps these hills safe. Go and keep them safe.
Master Saelen: The settlers fear a camp to the east. Fear spreads faster than raiders. End both.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.survey.jedi: Master Saelen: An old place nearby is stirring. Go to its heart and listen. Tell me what it says.
Master Saelen: The Force pools in old sites like water in stone. Reach the heart of one and feel how deep it runs.
Master Saelen: I want to know which of the old places are waking. Listen at one for me.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.secure_site: Master Saelen: Something guards an old site that should be sleeping. Put it to rest.
Master Saelen: Someone is waking the old guardians. Stop them before travellers pay for it.
Master Saelen: A site nearby has been taken by force. Take it back, and harm no one who flees.
Overseer Sorn: There is a raider camp nearby. They are weak and loud. Show them what strength is.
Overseer Sorn: A poacher crew thinks these hills are theirs. Teach them otherwise.
Overseer Sorn: The Empire has no use for vermin. Clear the camp, and do not take all day.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.survey.sith: Overseer Sorn: An old site lies close. Go to its heart and taste its power. Bring me its measure.
Overseer Sorn: Power sleeps in old stone. Find where it sleeps deepest.
Overseer Sorn: The old masters left their marks everywhere. Read one of them for me.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.secure_site: Overseer Sorn: Something holds an old site that belongs to us. Break it.
Overseer Sorn: Guardians of a dead order stand in your way. Remove them.
Overseer Sorn: That site has a keeper. The Empire is its keeper now. Make it so.
mission.oldrepublic.cameo.hessa.line: You again. I pay my debts. Take the record, and let my people walk away.
mission.oldrepublic.cameo.settler.line: You opened that cage for us. I owe you. The poachers used to whisper about an old chamber nobody has opened. Your journal will know the way.
mission.oldrepublic.note.r2_hessa: The smugglers' chief was Hessa Dray. She handed me the record without a fight and said she was paying her debts.
mission.oldrepublic.note.r2_lieutenant: Hessa Dray's lieutenant ran the cache now. He knew who had killed her, and he fought to the end.
mission.oldrepublic.note.settler: One of the settlers I freed has found work at the Republic outpost. She told me of an old chamber the poachers whispered about.
mission.oldrepublic.reason.i2.execute: Executed a sergeant who had surrendered
screen.oldrepublic.board.busy: Finish or abandon your current mission first.
screen.oldrepublic.board.abandon.hint: Stand down from your current mission. Its offer is gone for today.
screen.oldrepublic.board.hint: Two contracts per board each day.
screen.oldrepublic.board.notice.none: No contracts today. Come back tomorrow.

The Empire posts no work of its own for you below Neutral standing.
screen.oldrepublic.board.reward.over_cap: Full pay is spent for today
screen.oldrepublic.missions.heading: Missions
screen.oldrepublic.missions.none: No mission in hand. The outpost officers and their contract boards have work, and so may your mentor.

screen.oldrepublic.missions.locked.story: the story has not reached it
message.oldrepublic.mission.already_acti: You already have a mission in hand.
message.oldrepublic.mission.book_guarded: Dovan Lisk is not about to let you take his book.
message.oldrepublic.mission.crate_guarde: The sentinels still stand guard over the patrol.
message.oldrepublic.mission.crate_locked: The crate is locked, and its keeper still stands guard.
message.oldrepublic.mission.crew_fled: The crew has fled the camp.
message.oldrepublic.mission.gone: Your mission (%s) no longer exists and has been set aside.
message.oldrepublic.mission.item_reissue: You lost %s, but the site still held it. You take it again.
message.oldrepublic.mission.no_site: No site for this work could be found in range. The mission has been set aside.
message.oldrepublic.mission.not_here: Not here. Take it to the right officer.
message.oldrepublic.mission.offer_refuse: That offer is no longer open.
message.oldrepublic.mission.over_cap: You have worked %s contracts at full pay today. This one pays experience only.
message.oldrepublic.mission.site_found: The site is marked. Your tracker shows the way.
message.oldrepublic.mission.stand_down: The squad lowers its rifles and stands down. Their sergeant yields.
message.oldrepublic.mission.wounded_tend: The Imperial trooper gets to his feet. The post will hear of it.
message.oldrepublic.mission.req.no_duty: Your path has no mentor duty
mission.oldrepublic.c4_off_the_books.obj: Clear the poachers from the freighter's wreck
mission.oldrepublic.c4_greenwatch.title: The Greenwatch
mission.oldrepublic.c4_greenwatch.object: Cleanse two soured waystones: clear what has turned, then touch each stone with Sense
mission.oldrepublic.c4_heartstone.title: The Heartstone
mission.oldrepublic.c4_heartstone.object: Stand in the Heartstone's ring and keep the corruption back
mission.oldrepublic.c4_proving.title: The Proving
mission.oldrepublic.c4_proving.objective: Bring back a relic from a greater tomb's crypt
Bring the relic to Overseer Kaddor
mission.oldrepublic.c4_sepulchre.title: Zarvos's Sepulchre
mission.oldrepublic.c4_sepulchre.objecti: Survive the Sepulchre's rooms and face Zarvos's echo
mission.oldrepublic.c4_tessalys_road.obj: Follow the Compass to the Wayfarer cache
mission.oldrepublic.c4_both_doors.title: Both Doors
mission.oldrepublic.c4_both_doors.object: Cleanse a soured waystone, or bring a tomb relic, for the other hub
Bring the relic to Overseer Kaddor
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_cleanse.obj: Read the waystone with Sense or a scanner, or cleanse it
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_cull.title: Cull the Herd
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_recover.obj: Defeat the Watchers standing over the waystone
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_survey.obje: Reach the waystone and read it with Sense or a scanner
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_escort.obje: Walk the apprentice to the waystone
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_spar.title: A Bout in the Garden
mission.oldrepublic.selvaren_spar.object: Win a training bout against an apprentice
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_cleanse.obj: Destroy the restless sentinels at the tomb's gate
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_cull.title: Cull the Pack
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_recover.obj: Destroy the rogue security droids at the dig camp
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_survey.obje: Reach the greater tomb and read it with Sense or a scanner
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_escort.obje: Walk the acolyte to the tomb mouth
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_spar.title: Drill Yard Bout
mission.oldrepublic.varkhast_spar.object: Win a duel in the drill yard against an acolyte
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_cl: A waystone near the enclave has soured. Read it, cleanse it, and tell us what it said.
The Keeper wants a soured stone looked at. Sense, a scanner, or your own hands on it: whatever works.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_cu: A herd has gone mad near the tarns. Put them down before they trample the gardens.
The corruption has turned a hollowhorn herd. Cull them. Quickly, and without cruelty.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_re: Watchers have woken at a waystone and will not let anyone near. Lay them to rest.
Old sentinels stand guard over a stone they no longer understand. Clear them so we can study it.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_su: We need fresh readings from a waystone. Go and listen to it.
A stone out past the meadow has gone quiet. Find out why.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_es: One of our apprentices needs to reach a waystone to study it. Keep them alive on the way.
Walk an apprentice to the nearest waystone. They are braver than they are careful.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.selvaren_sp: The apprentices need a partner who does not go easy on them. Win a bout.
Training blades in the garden. Show an apprentice how it is done.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_cl: The dead at a tomb gate are restless again. Put them back to sleep.
Sentinels walk at a tomb gate. Destroy them so the diggers can work.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_cu: An ash hound pack is hunting near the road. Cull it.
Hounds have taken a supply runner. Make the pack smaller.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_re: Security droids at a dig camp have stopped answering. Destroy them before they decide who to shoot.
Rogue droids hold a tomb dig. Clear them out.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_su: The archive wants readings from a greater tomb. Go down and get them.
Survey a tomb. Do not touch anything that hums.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_es: An acolyte needs to reach a tomb mouth for their trial. See that they arrive.
Escort an acolyte to the tomb mouth. If they die on the way, so does your pay.
mission.oldrepublic.contract.varkhast_sp: A duel in the drill yard. The acolytes need to see someone win properly.
The drill yard is open. Win your bout and be seen doing it.
message.oldrepublic.mission.escort_lost: Your escort has fallen. The contract is lost.
screen.oldrepublic.board.notice.standing: The Watch posts no work of its own for you below Neutral standing.
message.oldrepublic.mission.space.no_fli: Free flight is off on this server; this contract cannot be flown.
message.oldrepublic.mission.space.no_shi: You need a ship for this contract.
message.oldrepublic.mission.space.refuse: Your ship cannot take this run now. Check its state and its hold.

The clan posts no work for you below Neutral standing.
mission.oldrepublic.c5_debt.title: A Debt in the Canyons
mission.oldrepublic.c5_debt.objective.ac: Get Orvo Plint's strongbox from his canyon camp
mission.oldrepublic.c5_debt.objective.re: Take the strongbox, or a good story, to Ommo Teel
mission.oldrepublic.c5_cargo.title: The Quiet Cargo
mission.oldrepublic.c5_cargo.objective.a: Fly the sealed crate to the nav buoy without a Clan Hask scan
mission.oldrepublic.c5_matriarch.title: The Matriarch
mission.oldrepublic.c5_matriarch.objecti: Hunt the sand scour matriarch and her brood in the dunes
mission.oldrepublic.c5_honour.title: A Duel of Honour
Fight Varra's champion, blade to blade, until one of you yields
mission.oldrepublic.c5_counting_house.ob: Reach Imrel Dask at the top of the counting-house
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_col: A salvage crew in the canyons stopped paying. The kajidic would like them to start again, or to stop being a crew.
Debts go bad in the canyon heat. Go and collect what is left of this one.
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_recover.obje: Drive the scavengers off the crashed freighter
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_rec: A freighter came down in the dunes with kajidic cargo aboard. Others found it first. Persuade them otherwise.
Kajidic cargo is lying in a broken hull out in the sand, and scavengers are picking it clean. Stop them.
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_cull.title: Scour Brood
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_cul: Sand scours have been taking pack beasts on the caravan road. Thin the brood.
A brood is nesting too close to the walls. The kajidic pays for quiet sand.
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_escort.title: A Factor's Walk
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_escort.objec: Walk the kajidic's factor to the canyon post
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_esc: One of the kajidic's factors has business at a canyon post and no wish to be robbed on the way. Walk with him.
A factor needs an escort to a canyon post. He talks a great deal. Keep him alive anyway.
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_run.title: A Quiet Run
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_run.objectiv: Fly the sealed crate to the nav buoy without being scanned
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_run: A crate needs to leave Ghessar's orbit without anyone counting it. Fly it to the buoy, and do not get scanned.
The kajidic has cargo for a buoy at the system's edge. The patrols would love to know what is in it. Do not let them.
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_bounty.title: Bounty: an Ace
mission.oldrepublic.ghessar_bounty.objec: Shoot down the ace and their wing
mission.oldrepublic.contract.ghessar_bou: A pilot has been robbing kajidic shipping in orbit. The board pays well for the ace's ship.
Today's bounty: an ace and their wing, somewhere in orbit. Bring back proof in the shape of wreckage.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_hunt.title: Stormback Hunt
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_hun: A stormback has been charging our warriors' posts. Hunt it like one of us.
The clan wants a stormback's hide. Mind the lightning; it likes them.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_spar.title: A Bout with the Clan
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_spar.objecti: Win a bout against the clan's champion
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_spa: A clan warrior wants to test the outsider. Win the bout, and the clan will know your name.
Blades in the holdfast yard. The champion is waiting.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_cleanse.obje: Clear the Hymnsworn from their shrine
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_cle: The witch's Hymnsworn have raised a shrine in the stormwood. Tear it down.
Hymnsworn are chanting at a shrine too close to our hunting grounds. Make them stop.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_recover.obje: Clear what guards the fallen warrior's grave in the mire
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_rec: A clan warrior fell in the mire last winter. Bring her helmet home; something guards it now.
Clan iron lies in the mire with a warrior who never came back. Recover it.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_patrol.title: Orbital Patrol
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_patrol.objec: Clear the raiders from Tyrvann's orbit
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_pat: Raiders are working Tyrvann's orbit. Fly a patrol with the clan's blessing and clear them out.
The clan's fighters are stretched thin. Take a patrol over Tyrvann and bring down whatever shoots at you.
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_bounty.title: Bounty: an Ace
mission.oldrepublic.tyrvann_bounty.objec: Shoot down the ace and their wing
mission.oldrepublic.contract.tyrvann_bou: An ace has been hunting the clan's pilots. The board pays for their ship.
Today's bounty: an ace and their wing. The clan wants them gone.
screen.oldrepublic.board.bounty.taken: Taken today. The board posts another tomorrow.
